item.title: Azon Dominator SQL Injection via fetch products.php cid parameter
item.description: Azon Dominator releases through 2024-06-03 contain an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries through the cid parameter in /fetch products.php. Attackers can send crafted POST requests with boolean-based or time-based blind payloads to extract sensitive database information. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2024-07-30.

item.title: CmsEasy 7.7.5 20210919 Unauthenticated SQL Injection via crossall execsql
item.description: CmsEasy 7.7.5 20210919 contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the execsql action function at /?case=crossall&act=execsql that executes attacker-supplied queries decrypted with the hardcoded key 'cmseasy sql'. Attackers can send a crafted 'sql' parameter to run arbitrary SQL and dump the admin username and password hash. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on…

item.title: LiveBOS Unauthenticated Path Traversal File Read via ShowImage.do
item.description: LiveBOS builds through 2023-08-16 contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary files via the imgName parameter in /feed/ShowImage.do using a ';.js.jsp' suffix bypass. Attackers can send crafted GET requests with directory traversal sequences in imgName to read system files such as /etc/passwd. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation…

item.title: Grav 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 Unbounded Cache Growth via Host Header
item.description: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to fill the disk by varying the HTTP Host header. Attackers can send requests with distinct Host values to create per-host compiled configuration, blueprint, language and page index caches, causing session, upload and logging failures.

item.title: Grav 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 Access Control Bypass via Page Cache Poisoning
item.description: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains an access control bypass vulnerability that allows anonymous visitors to read protected pages because admin and site scopes share a page cache key. Routine editor activity through the API plugin rebuilds the page index without frontmatter.yaml access rules, exposing members-only page content until the cache is rebuilt.

item.title: Grav 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 Arbitrary File Read via Twig Sandbox Bypass
item.description: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a Twig sandbox bypass vulnerability that allows publishers to read any server file by abusing allowlisted array key value() and page accessor setters such as filePath(). Attackers can repoint page objects or overwrite the assets collections to render private keys and the API signing secret, then forge a super-admin API token.

item.title: Grav 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 Privilege Escalation via YAML Merge Key
item.description: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows user managers to grant super-admin rights by nesting access maps under a YAML merge key. Attackers with admin.users.create or api.users.write can submit ' , that bypass super-grant filtering and gain full site control.

item.title: Grav 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 Authorization Bypass via Flex Pages Storage
item.description: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows publishers to overwrite pages their per-page permissions deny by abusing FolderStorage key delimiter collisions and PageStorage folder reconstruction. Attackers can rename a folder like locked or save from a page with an unusual prefix width through a front-end Flex pages form, replacing protected content and permissions to…

item.title: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 Row Filter Bypass via Shared View Relation Endpoints
item.description: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an authorization bypass in its public shared-view relation endpoints, which verify that a parent record exists but not that it passes the view's row filters. Unauthenticated attackers holding a public share link can supply guessable auto-incrementing ids of filtered-out records to has-many, many-to-many, one-many, or link endpoints to read their child records.

item.title: NocoDB 2026.06.2 before 2026.08.0 Read-Only Source Bypass via Internal Batch API
item.description: NocoDB from 2026.06.2 before 2026.08.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated base Editors to write to data-read-only sources by abusing the internal batch endpoint. Attackers can name a writable decoy table on the batch envelope and target a read-only source table in dataUpdate, dataInsert or dataDelete sub-operations to modify or destroy records.

item.title: NocoDB before 2026.04.1 Password Reset Token Not Invalidated on Password Change
item.description: NocoDB before 2026.04.1 fails to clear reset password token and reset password expires in users.service.ts when a password is changed, leaving earlier reset links valid. Attackers holding an unexpired reset link, such as from prior mailbox access, can set a new password and regain control of the account.

item.title: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 Server-Side Template Injection via Webhook Helpers
item.description: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains a server-side template injection vulnerability that allows authenticated Creator or Owner users to execute JavaScript by abusing Handlebars webhook helpers. Attackers can supply property paths like constructor.constructor to pluck, sortBy, filter, or withSort helpers to reach the Function constructor and run operating-system commands.

item.title: Svelte affected by XSS in SSR element
item.description: In certain circumstances, the server-side rendering output of an element does not properly escape its content, potentially allowing HTML injection in the SSR output. Client-side rendering is not affected.

item.title: wcmatch: Polynomial-time ReDoS when matching untrusted names against multi-star patterns (default flags)
item.description: Summary With default flags, a pattern that contains several wildcards takes polynomial time, O(n^k) for k stars, to reject a crafted file name. The pattern is an ordinary developer constant such as .csv ; only the string being matched comes from the attacker. A 255-byte file name (the maximum on common filesystems) takes 73 s with fnmatch.fnmatch() and 86 s with glob.globmatch() . The standard library's fnmatch…

A group containing N elements that point to another such group multiplies the work by N per nesting level, so an SVG of about 1.4 KB makes svglib clone and render over 100,000 nodes, taking tens of seconds of CPU time and hundreds of MiB of memory. item.description: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

item.title: Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
item.description: Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint, which accepts and deserializes vendor extension types before authentication. This CVE covers the same underlying vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384 but applies to a broader range of affected versions.
